info.title: Items API (C1 Sensitivity vs Clearance Gate Demo)
info.description: A tiny mocked REST API used to demo the C1 Sensitivity vs Clearance Gate Flex Gateway policy. Provider: P4A Policies for Agents (https://github.com/P4A-Policies-for-Agents). The same GET /items/{id} endpoint returns content of very different sensitivity depending on id: blurb is a public product description; record is a customer record containing restricted personal data. The gateway policy classifies each RESPONSE and blocks it when it exceeds the caller's clearance — the mock itself does no authorization.

get.description: Returns an item by id. blurb returns a public product blurb; record returns a customer record with restricted personal data. The gateway policy screens the RESPONSE against the caller's x-data-clearance header; this mock does no authorization.

parameters.name: x-data-clearance
parameters.description: Caller clearance (public|internal|confidential|restricted). Read by the gateway policy, ignored by this mock.

blurb.summary: Public product blurb (any caller may see it)

value.name: AeroWhisk 3000 blender
value.description: Our flagship blender ships in three colours and whips soup smooth in 30 seconds. In stores now.

record.summary: Customer record with restricted personal data
